scope: Isolated macOS prototype; production reader, platform hosts and default renderer unchanged.
backend: Impeller/Metal for both Canvas paths; no native external texture bridge

benchmark.method: Interleaved paired renderers; same prepared real textures per layout; two forward/reverse cycles after warmup.

visual.note: Both backends pass page recovery, cancellation, RTL and texture budget checks. Shader has more aliased curved text in inspected EPUB corners, plus different shadows; visual quality is not equivalent.

recommendation: On tested M5 Pro, Flutter fragment shader is the faster macOS candidate. Before production adoption under Apple Books-like quality requirements, improve curved texture sampling/antialiasing and assess shadow differences. Retain mesh as fallback; do not migrate to the tested native Metal external texture path. iOS recommendation remains mesh.
limitations: Warm automated animation data; not native mouse/trackpad-to-display latency.
Raster wall time is not isolated GPU kernel time. Pipeline budget exceedance is not a measured dropped-frame rate.
Only M5 Pro tested; no Intel or other Mac GPU conclusion. No 120 Hz presentation verification.
Functional pointers are delivered through Flutter integration tests, not native input automation.
Full-frame RGB MAE is a descriptive difference, not a visual quality score.
No Apple Books side-by-side visual comparison; paper model remains approximate.
privacy: Anonymous JSON only; source books, titles, absolute paths, screenshots and console logs remain outside the repository.
